scope: Initial, incomplete source-backed release. Verified means the rename is supported by cited evidence, not current-live-register or geometry verification.

countries.name: Ukraine
gaps: Current national directory and Kyiv street register not reconciled; Kharkiv includes the 48 street entries of order 513 В (26 July 2024) plus non-overlapping postal-classifier mappings; full legal-history and geometry reconciliation remains incomplete
Coverage outside Kyiv and the captured Lviv-region appendix remains unimported: Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Chernihiv, Sumy, Zhytomyr, Rivne and other municipalities
Lviv appendix 2 recovered: 118 published mappings; 10 Lviv/Briukhovychi rows held for municipal-decision reconciliation

countries.name: Poland
gaps: TERYT/ULIC current-register comparison not completed; Łódź has 151 reviewed mappings, including historical chains and current-register checks for the 46 additions; not its full historical inventory
Wrocław, Poznań, Gdańsk, Szczecin, Katowice, Lublin, Białystok and other municipalities not imported

countries.name: South Africa
gaps: No municipal GIS geometry imported; Cape Town coverage is limited to eight unambiguous mappings; conflicting Lansdowne segments held for review; Pretoria includes the visitor map table with Church Street segments preserved
Ekurhuleni, Mangaung, Msunduzi, Buffalo City, Nelson Mandela Bay and other municipalities remain gaps
Durban combined streets and suspicious spellings held for review

countries.name: Vietnam
gaps: Ho Chi Minh City: officially confirmed partial rename plus independently corroborated historical entries; remaining historical leads held for review
Đà Nẵng resolution 66/2024 inspected: new roads and bridge names, not genuine street renames; excluded
Hanoi source leads mostly new naming, length changes or drafts; not published as renames
Huế, Hải Phòng, Cần Thơ and other municipalities not imported; historical Saigon table not reconciled

countries.name: Kazakhstan
gaps: Almaty, Astana and Shymkent decisions imported; no GIS reconciliation
Karaganda, Pavlodar, Aktobe, Kostanay, Semey, Öskemen, Taraz, Atyrau and other municipalities not imported

countries.name: India
gaps: Delhi historical decisions imported, proposals excluded; Chennai pending text verification; Kolkata has one municipal-newsletter mapping, with the partial Moore Avenue lead held for review
Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad and other municipalities not imported
British Council historical table not imported; newer municipal registers not systematically compared
